todo_line: - [ ] 002 Implement and focused-test the Messaging `RequestGroupAccess` composite command: derive requester, club, destination, subject, body, and club-hosted add URL server-side at the stable authorization checkpoint; resolve Admin Group recipients; dispatch existing `SendMessage`; propagate its result; and leave general web composition unchanged.

validation.evidence: 17 tests passed with 0 failures. Coverage proves the fixed ordinary Admin MessageSent/access/delivery event shape, authoritative server-owned content and URL, current Admin-only recipients, no target-group admission, forged-field immunity, all specified rejection categories without MessageSent, stale-projection departure rejection, existing-Admin sender delivery/access/follow behavior, no inline Fake-provider handoff, exact :ok/execution-result/error propagation, the public no-CRUD inventory, and the unchanged exact Messaging router registry.

30 tests passed with 0 failures, retaining the authoritative Membership resolver, ordinary message-send semantics, stable-checkpoint behavior, and unchanged group email posting policy. The run emitted known asynchronous projector ownership/consistency teardown logs from an existing stale-projection test but exited successfully.
All changed Elixir source and test files are formatted.

notes:
The public input is `%{message_id: message_id, club_id: authenticated_club_id, requester_person_id: authenticated_person_id, group_id: target_group_id}` plus normal dispatch options; extra sender, audience, recipient, name, slug, subject, body, and URL facts are ignored. `RequestGroupAccess` is a plain application-layer intent and was not added to `Memba.Messaging.Router`; only its constituent `SendMessage` is dispatched. The accepted authoritative resolver supplies the requester person ID/name, active membership/current participation, club ID/name/slug, and custom-group ID/name. The fixed subject is `Access request: <group name>` and the fixed body is `<requester> would like to join <group>.

<requester> asked from <group>'s page in <club>.

Add <requester> to <group>:
<club URL>

You'll confirm on the website before <requester> is added.` An example test URL is `http://kmc.lvh.me:4002/groups/grp_<uuid>/members/add/per_<uuid>`. Named focused tests cover fixed ordinary Admin send/non-membership/forged fields, current Admin recipients, all invalid and ineligible targets without MessageSent, stale projected departure, existing-Admin ordinary behavior, and dispatch-result propagation. Initial TDD runs failed as expected before the API existed and once on a test-only trailing-newline expectation; both were superseded by the successful final runs.
